note.zh: 受控源分散在 `basics`（四种受控源）和 `methods`（含受控源的结点法、网孔法）里，没有单独的一章。
note.en: Dependent sources are spread over `basics` (the four kinds) and `methods` (nodal and mesh analysis with dependent sources); there is no chapter of their own.

note.zh: 一个单元只讲一个想法，每个 10–15 分钟。按顺序学：先看懂芯片，再看懂“虚短”从哪来，后面每个电路都用同一套五步法。
note.en: One idea per unit, 10–15 minutes each. Go in order: the chip first, then where the "virtual short" comes from; every circuit after that uses the same five steps.

title.zh: 面包板实验（单元里也有入口）
title.en: Breadboard labs (also linked from the units)

note.zh: 14 道题都挂在上面的单元里。
note.en: All 14 problems are linked from the units above.

title.zh: 储能元件与一阶 / 二阶暂态
title.en: Energy storage, first- and second-order transients

title.zh: 正弦稳态、相量与交流功率
title.en: Sinusoidal steady state, phasors and AC power

note.zh: Part B 的前半（相量、阻抗、RC 频率响应）是 World 7 波特图与滤波的前置。
note.en: The first half of Part B (phasors, impedance, RC frequency response) comes before World 7's Bode plots and filters.

title.zh: Part A · ET-110 期末（Week 12–14）＝ ET-140 Week 1–6 前半
title.en: Part A · ET-110 final (Week 12–14) = first half of ET-140 Week 1–6

note.zh: 前半（RC 低通 / 高通、带通）是 World 7 的前置。
note.en: The first half (RC low-pass / high-pass, band-pass) comes before World 7.

title.zh: 半导体器件与分立放大器
模拟 IC 进阶：非理想运放、波特图、有源滤波、555 与功放
title.en: Analog ICs: real op-amps, Bode plots, active filters, 555 and power amps

title.zh: 数字逻辑、MCU 与传感器实战
UB 衔接 / 选修理论区

course.zh: 回 UB 后的 EE 课程（不计入主线进度）
course.en: EE courses back at UB (not counted in main-line progress)

textbook.en: Second half of Sadiku and beyond

note.zh: 这些是 Sadiku 后半本的内容，不在 QCC ET-220 范围内。想提前看可以随时做。
note.en: These come from the second half of Sadiku and are outside QCC's ET-220. Do them any time if you want a head start.

title.zh: 交流功率与功率因数校正

what.zh: 在面包板上测有功、无功功率，并联电容把功率因数拉回 1。
what.en: Measure real and reactive power on the board and add a parallel capacitor to bring the power factor back to 1.

title.en: Half-wave rectifier with a filter capacitor

what.zh: 一个二极管把交流变成脉动直流，电容把它抹平，纹波有多大。
what.en: One diode turns AC into pulsing DC, a capacitor smooths it; how big is the ripple.

what.zh: 反向击穿的二极管为什么能稳住电压，限流电阻怎么选。
what.en: Why a diode in reverse breakdown holds a voltage, and how to pick the series resistor.

what.zh: 用二极管切掉或平移波形（ET-140 Lab #5）。
what.en: Cut off or shift a waveform with diodes (ET-140 Lab #5).

title.zh: 全波桥式整流与直流电源链
title.en: Full-wave bridge rectifier and the DC supply chain

what.zh: 变压器 → 整流桥 → 滤波电容 → 稳压，一个直流电源是怎么搭出来的。
what.en: Transformer → bridge → filter capacitor → regulator: how a DC supply is built.

title.zh: BJT 特性曲线、分压式偏置与直流负载线
title.en: BJT curves, voltage-divider bias and the DC load line

what.zh: 让三极管工作在放大区：偏置电阻怎么算，工作点落在负载线哪里。
what.en: Keep a BJT in its active region: computing the bias resistors and where the Q-point sits on the load line.

what.zh: 两个晶体管怎么分一股电流，为什么只对两个输入的差值敏感。
what.en: How two transistors share one current, and why they only respond to the difference of the inputs.

title.zh: BJT 小信号 r_e 模型、共射放大器与射极跟随器
title.en: BJT small-signal r_e model, common-emitter amplifier and emitter follower

what.zh: 增益从哪来：小信号模型、共射放大的增益和射极跟随器的低输出电阻。
what.en: Where gain comes from: the small-signal model, common-emitter gain and the emitter follower's low output resistance.

what.zh: 电压控制的场效应管怎么做放大器。
what.en: An amplifier from a voltage-controlled field-effect transistor.

title.zh: 拆开 LM358：内部三级的定量分析
title.en: Inside the LM358: the three stages, with numbers

what.zh: 输入级、增益级、输出级各贡献多少增益和带宽。
what.en: How much gain and bandwidth each stage contributes.

title.zh: 非理想运放：增益带宽积 GBW

what.zh: 补偿电容让增益随频率下降；GBW 告诉你一个放大器能用到多高的频率。
what.en: The compensation capacitor makes gain fall with frequency; GBW tells you how high an amplifier still works.

what.zh: 输出跟不上、零输入却有输出：现象、原因、怎么测（ET-220 Lab 9–10）。
what.en: An output that can't keep up, an output with zero input: what you see, why, how to measure it (ET-220 Lab 9–10).

what.zh: 用两种阻值的电阻梯把数字变成电压。
what.en: Turn a binary number into a voltage with a ladder of two resistor values.

what.zh: 用 dB 和对数频率轴画频率响应，渐近线怎么画。
what.en: Frequency response in dB on a log axis, and how to sketch the asymptotes.

title.zh: 二阶有源高通与陷波器
title.en: Second-order active high-pass and notch filters

what.zh: ET-220 Lab 11–12 的两种滤波器。
what.en: The two filters of ET-220 Lab 11–12.

title.zh: 共射放大器的频率响应
title.en: Frequency response of the common-emitter amplifier

what.zh: 耦合电容和晶体管电容决定了低频和高频的截止点（ET-220 Week 11）。
what.en: Coupling and transistor capacitances set the low and high cutoffs (ET-220 Week 11).

title.zh: 555 定时器与压控振荡器 VCO

what.zh: 两个比较器加一个触发器，做出方波和可调频率的振荡器。
what.en: Two comparators and a flip-flop make a square wave and a voltage-controlled oscillator.

title.zh: Class A / B / AB 推挽功放与运放输出扩流
title.en: Class A / B / AB push-pull amplifiers and op-amp current boosting

what.zh: 交越失真从哪来，输出为什么到不了电源轨，怎么加管子扩大电流（Lab 13）。
what.en: Where crossover distortion comes from, why the output can't reach the rails, and boosting current with transistors (Lab 13).

what.zh: 给比较器加正反馈，得到两个阈值，噪声不再让输出乱跳。
what.en: Positive feedback gives a comparator two thresholds, so noise no longer makes the output chatter.

title.zh: CMOS 反相器与 74HC 逻辑门

what.zh: 一对 MOSFET 怎么做出反相器，再搭成真正的逻辑门芯片。
what.en: How a MOSFET pair makes an inverter, and from there a real logic-gate chip.

title.zh: 布尔代数、德摩根定律与卡诺图
title.en: Boolean algebra, De Morgan's laws and Karnaugh maps

what.zh: 把逻辑式化简到最少的门。
what.en: Simplify a logic expression to the fewest gates.

what.zh: 用逻辑门做二进制加法。
what.en: Binary addition from logic gates.

what.zh: 把 4 位二进制数显示成一个数字。
what.en: Show a 4-bit number as a digit.

title.zh: D / JK 触发器与同步计数器
title.en: D / JK flip-flops and synchronous counters

what.zh: 能记住一位的电路，以及用它们数数。
what.en: Circuits that remember one bit, and counting with them.

what.zh: 给数字电路一个节拍：用 555 做时钟振荡器（ET-540 Lab 9）。
what.en: Give a digital circuit its beat: a 555 clock oscillator (ET-540 Lab 9).
